liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): The transition into I Know You Rider is especially memorable [10]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): The transition into Deal is a one-time-only occurrence [12]
- **Turn On Your Lovelight** (1 review): Pig lets it all hang out in one of the last performances [11]

## The recordings

- **gd1971-12-15.sbd.miller.97718.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 25 songs; 169 min; rated 4.69/5 by 35 [1]. Said about its sound: The recording quality is exceptionally good, with high energy and top form performance; Keith is prominent in the mix, while the organ is relatively undetectable; The piano is louder, showcasing Keith's prowess, while the organ is quiet [7][10][14][16]
- **gd1971-12-15.149966.sbd.mr.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 25 songs; 174 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1971-12-15.149830.sbd.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 25 songs; 174 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1971-12-15.sbd.Oleynick.134.shnf**: soundboard; 9 songs; 58 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [4]

## Around the show

- Jerry responds to a crowd yell by making the piano louder [14]
- Supports the claim that Keith was better in late 1971 than in 1977 [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1971-12-15.sbd.miller.97718.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat (48k) [1]. Also: Credit is given to Senor Miller for the transfer work; Downloaded specifically because it is a Charlie Miller transfer, unlike other copies; Rob Eaton's Dat source was used because it sounded better than the patch source [1][7][8]
- **gd1971-12-15.149966.sbd.mr.miller.flac16**: taped by Ramrod; transferred by Transferred by Rob Eaton Mastered by Charlie Miller  April 3, 2020; source: SBD > Master Reel > Pro Tools > FLAC/24 [2]. Also: Tape pauses were patched using Rob Eaton's FM Dats [2]
- **gd1971-12-15.149830.sbd.miller.flac2496**: taped by Recorded by Ramrod; transferred by Transferred by Rob Eaton Mastered by Charlie Miller  April 3, 2020; source: SBD > Master Reel > Pro Tools > FLAC/24 [3]. Also: All sources for the project were supplied by Rob Eaton [3]
- **gd1971-12-15.sbd.Oleynick.134.shnf**: transferred by Extraction/SHN by John Oleynick; source: SBD>?>CDR>EAC>SHN [4]
